# Neuri

> Neuri (Neuri LLC, Phoenix, Arizona, USA) builds a suite of AI agents that help small and growing US businesses win back hours and sell more, in English and Spanish. Four products: neuri.bots, neuri.bazar, neuri.consulting and neuri.marketing. Prices in US dollars. Contact: hola@neuri.tech

Neuri crea agentes de IA para negocios en Estados Unidos, en inglés y en español: neuri.bots contesta tus mensajes de Instagram, Facebook y WhatsApp, neuri.bazar lleva la caja y los vendedores de tu bazar, neuri.consulting te ayuda a poner la IA a trabajar y neuri.marketing prepara tus posts para que solo los apruebes. Precios en dólares.

Price promise (neuri.bazar, neuri.bots, neuri.marketing): while a subscription stays active, its monthly price does not go up. It does not cover switching plans, canceling and resubscribing, or taxes; founders' prices last as their written offer says.

- [Neuri home (English)](https://neuri.tech/) · [Inicio en español](https://neuri.tech/es/)

## neuri.bots

Answers a business's customer messages on Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp (plus Telegram and a website chat; TikTok and SMS are coming) from the owner's own catalog sheet: "is this still available?", price and payment, holds items, books appointments, takes orders, and DMs a link to people who comment. It does not make things up: unknown questions go to the owner. The owner sets it up at their own pace (or with their AI assistant). Month to month, no contract; a 7-day free trial (card added when it is turned on; charged on day 8, cancel before and you pay nothing).

- Basic US$49/month · Pro US$69/month
- [neuri.bots (English)](https://neuri.tech/en/still-available/) · [Español](https://neuri.tech/sigue-disponible/)
- Comparison: [neuri.bots vs ManyChat (English)](https://neuri.tech/en/still-available/vs-manychat/) · [Español](https://neuri.tech/sigue-disponible/vs-manychat/)

## neuri.bazar

Point of sale for antique malls, vendor malls, consignment shops and makers markets that rent booths: ring up sales on a phone; each vendor's sales, rent and payouts add up automatically. 14 days free.

- Basic US$79 · Pro US$119 · Plus US$149 per month
- Basic: up to 30 vendors and 1 register · Pro: up to 75 vendors and 3 registers · Plus: unlimited vendors and registers, plus a public website with the whole inventory. Flat monthly price, no fee on sales.
- [neuri.bazar (English)](https://neuri.tech/en/bazar/) · [Español](https://neuri.tech/bazar/) · [Tour with real screens](https://neuri.tech/en/bazar/tour/) · [Recorrido con pantallas reales](https://neuri.tech/bazar/recorrido/)
- Comparison: [neuri.bazar vs Quail (English)](https://neuri.tech/en/bazar/vs-quail/) · [Español](https://neuri.tech/bazar/vs-quail/) · [neuri.bazar vs Ricochet (English)](https://neuri.tech/en/bazar/vs-ricochet/) · [Español](https://neuri.tech/bazar/vs-ricochet/)

## neuri.consulting

AI consulting for companies: a virtual AI diagnostic, then implementation of agents that prospect customers, automate operations and deliver reporting. Diagnostic from US$249.

- [Neuri Consulting (English)](https://consulting.neuri.tech/?lang=en) · [Español](https://consulting.neuri.tech/)
- [Diagnostic site and pricing](https://consulting.neuri.tech/precios) · [llms.txt](https://consulting.neuri.tech/llms.txt)

## neuri.marketing

AI marketing hub for growing businesses: brand kit, a 30-day content calendar, posts and reels drafted with the business's own photos, one-tap approval, then scheduling on Instagram and Facebook. New accounts are not open yet: sign-up opens once Instagram and Facebook can be connected through Meta's official login. Sample at https://marketing.neuri.tech/demo. Nothing is posted without the owner's approval. Free tools that work today, no sign-up: 2026 guide, profile score, templates by business type, reel ideas with 3-shot scripts, ready-to-copy comment replies, brand sheet.

- Start US$49 · Grow US$99 · Pro US$169 per month
- [neuri.marketing (English)](https://neuri.tech/en/marketing/) · [Español](https://neuri.tech/marketing/)
- Comparison: [neuri.marketing vs Predis.ai (English)](https://neuri.tech/en/marketing/vs-predis/) · [Español](https://neuri.tech/marketing/vs-predis/)
- Free tools: [2026 guide](https://marketing.neuri.tech/guia?lang=en) · [Profile self-check](https://marketing.neuri.tech/diagnostico?lang=en) · [Templates by business type](https://marketing.neuri.tech/plantillas?lang=en) · [Reel ideas](https://marketing.neuri.tech/ideas-reels?lang=en) · [Comment replies](https://marketing.neuri.tech/respuestas?lang=en) · [Brand sheet](https://marketing.neuri.tech/marca?lang=en) (Spanish: drop ?lang=en)
